title: Рисунки от Кей
alt: Kay's Daily Doodles / Kay-chan no Enikki Kay's Daily Doodles 小刻的画图写话
description: One, two, one, two, line up! Bow! Welcome! Hello, Doctor, I'm Beanstalk, and as of today, the Metal Crab Café is officially open for business in Rhodes Island, staffed by my adorable crew, including Rock, Hercules, and... Those three? You mean little Kay, Bubble, and Popukar? No, no, they're not staff, they're... Well, you'll find out when you come and have a cup of coffee! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

en:
One, two, one, two, line up! Bow! Welcome! Hello, Doctor, I'm Beanstalk, and as of today, the Metal Crab Café is officially open for business in Rhodes Island, staffed by my adorable crew, including Rock, Hercules, and... Those three? You mean little Kay, Bubble, and Popukar? No, no, they're not staff, they're... Well, you'll find out when you come and have a cup of coffee!



(Source: Bilibili, translated)
